description: This file implements the RequestHandler class for managing storage directories, including creation, deletion, and quota management, within a plugin-based system. It handles app-specific storage info, filesystem operations, and persistent property interactions.

classes.name: RequestHandler
classes.description: Manages app storage directories, including creation, deletion, quota management, and filesystem operations within a plugin system.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of RequestHandler.

methods.name: setCurrentService
methods.description: Sets the current service interface for the request handler.

methods.name: populateAppInfoCacheFromStoragePath
methods.description: Populates the internal cache of app storage info by scanning the storage path.

methods.name: createPersistentStoreRemoteStoreObject
methods.description: Creates the remote persistent store object for property management.

methods.name: releasePersistentStoreRemoteStoreObject
methods.description: Releases the persistent store object.

methods.name: isValidAppStorageDirectory
methods.description: Validates if a directory name is a proper app ID based on naming rules.

methods.name: appQuotaSizeProperty
methods.description: Gets, sets, or deletes the quota size property for an app in persistent storage.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Callback used by nftw to accumulate file sizes for storage calculations.

methods.name: getDirectorySizeInBytes
methods.description: Calculates total size of a directory by traversing its contents.

methods.name: createAppStorageInfoByAppID
methods.description: Creates or updates storage info for an app in the internal map.

methods.name: retrieveAppStorageInfoByAppID
methods.description: Retrieves storage info for an app, verifying accessibility.

methods.name: removeAppStorageInfoByAppID
methods.description: Removes storage info for an app from the internal map.

methods.name: hasEnoughStorageFreeSpace
methods.description: Checks if there is sufficient free space to create a new app storage directory.

methods.name: CreateStorage
methods.description: Creates storage for an app, including directory creation and quota assignment.

methods.name: GetStorage
methods.description: Retrieves storage info and optionally updates ownership.

methods.name: DeleteStorage
methods.description: Deletes an app's storage directory and info.

methods.name: deleteCallback
methods.description: Callback for nftw to delete files and directories.

methods.name: deleteDirectoryEntries
methods.description: Deletes all entries within a directory.

methods.name: lockAppStorageInfo
methods.description: Locks storage info for thread-safe access.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears storage for a specific app.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears all app storage except exempted apps.

methods.name: SetBaseStoragePath
methods.description: Sets the base path for storage directories.
